components.html: Reddit
components.css: .ds-sky{padding:40px 24px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 70% at 50% 0,#030b2b 60%,#1f4bff 88%,#c2d5ff 100%)}.ds-composer{max-width:520px;margin:auto;padding:14px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8);border-radius:24px;background:rgba(236,242,255,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(1.5);box-shadow:0 30px 60px -24px rgba(6,24,110,.45);color:#0b1640;font:13px system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-composer label{font-weight:600}.ds-composer textarea{display:block;width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;font:17px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;resize:none;margin:6px 0}.ds-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid rgba(11,22,64,.08)}.ds-chip{height:30px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid rgba(11,22,64,.1);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);font-weight:500}.ds-run{height:40px;padding:0 18px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:#2457f5;color:#fff;font-weight:500}

components.css: .ds-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px 1fr;padding:24px 28px 20px 20px;border:1px solid #dbe4f7;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(11,22,64,.06),0 18px 40px -24px rgba(20,50,170,.32);color:#0b1640;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-n{color:#2457f5;font:600 13px system-ui}.ds-tag{display:inline-flex;height:24px;align-items:center;padding:0 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#eef3ff;font:600 12px system-ui}.ds-card h3{margin:12px 0 0;font:500 20px/1.3 system-ui}.ds-card blockquote{margin:14px 0;padding:14px 18px;border-radius:14px;background:#eef3ff;font-size:15.5px}.ds-fit{padding:2px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(36,87,245,.08);color:#2457f5;font:600 12.5px system-ui}

narrative.overview: Night above the horizon holds the conversations you have not found yet; Run carries the composer across the rim and real matches surface in daylight below. Persuasion lives above the horizon, work lives below it.
keyCharacteristics: Dark elliptical dome with a glowing cobalt rim fading to ice and white.
Frosted composer with chip toolbar as the first-viewport object.
Real community names as drifting cursor tags and a faded strip.
White result cards with soft blue-tinted shadows; quotes on frost.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: No second hue; fictional examples use dashed outlines and labels.

rules.name: The Night Is Above Rule
rules.body: Dark surfaces only for the hero dome, docked bar and footer; reading happens on light.

rules.name: The Real Blur Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur only where something sits over the glow.

dos: Do keep the composer and Run action inside the first viewport on 375×812.
Do label every fictional example and keep the sample disclosure next to the action.
Do suppress drift, twinkle, pulse and the dock transition under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add invented users, testimonials, logos or metrics.
Don't add a second accent hue or gradient text.
Don't use colored side borders thicker than 1px.
Don't put long reading text on night surfaces.
